summary.text: Malcolm Ruff is the Democratic candidate for Maryland State Senate District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election. A trial attorney, he has served in the Maryland House of Delegates for District 41 since being appointed in 2023.

paragraphs.text: Ruff earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in African-American Studies from Duke University in 2006 and a J.D. from the University of Baltimore in 2012, and he is a trial attorney with the Baltimore law firm Murphy, Falcon & Murphy.
Gov. Wes Moore appointed Ruff to the House of Delegates for District 41 on June 22, 2023, to replace Tony Bridges.
In the 2025-2026 term he was assigned to the Appropriations Committee.
He is not running for re-election to the House; instead, he defeated incumbent state Senator Dalya Attar in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for District 41.
